description: Use this when the user wants to open a quote form for a local home-service business rather than book a confirmed appointment time. Opens the quote widget for one enrolled business. business_id is the provider_business_id from the business feed. shop_id is accepted when business_id is empty. The widget is ui://widget/request-service.html. This call does not store a request and does not confirm a booking. It is rate-limited.

business_id.description: Enrolled business id from search_businesses. Example: florida-pole-barn.

shop_id.description: Enrolled shop id. Used only when business_id is empty. Example: florida-security-concepts.

name: request_service

outputSchema.description: Opens the quote form. Does not store a request or confirm a booking.

title: Request a quote
